text: Recreational Classes Leap Together Parent & Tot Ages 18 months to 3 years 1 hour A coach-led introduction to gymnastics for young children, with a parent or caregiver participating alongside them. Children begin developing fundamental gymnastics movement through structured stations that introduce climbing, hanging, balancing, jumping, rolling, supported body positions and safe landings. Coaches guide both the child and caregiver while gradually building body awareness, coordination and confidence moving through a gymnastics environment. Leap Together gives young children an age-appropriate foundation for future independent gymnastics classes. Recreational Classes Little Leapers (Age 3) Age 3 1 hour An independent preschool gymnastics program designed specifically for three-year-olds who are ready to participate in class without a parent or caregiver. Gymnasts are introduced to fundamental gymnastics positions and skills through structured, coach-led stations. Training develops jumping and landing mechanics, rolls, balances, hangs and supports, basic body shapes, coordination and spatial awareness using age-appropriate gymnastics equipment. The focus is on building strong early gymnastics foundations while developing the listening, independence and body control needed to progress into more advanced preschool gymnastics. Recreational Classes Ready Set Leap (Ages 4–5) Ages 4-5 1 hour A foundational recreational gymnastics program where children begin developing skills across vault, bars, beam and floor. Gymnasts work on fundamental body positions, balances, rolls, handstand and cartwheel preparation, jumping and landing technique, bar supports and swings, and other age-appropriate gymnastics skills through structured progressions. Coaches adapt skills to each gymnast's ability and readiness, helping athletes develop proper technique, strength, flexibility, coordination and body control while preparing for continued recreational gymnastics development. Recreational Classes Rising Stars (Ages 6–7) Ages 6-7 1 hour A progressive recreational gymnastics program for school-age athletes, with structured training across vault, bars, beam and floor. Gymnasts develop and refine fundamental skills while progressing toward increasingly challenging gymnastics elements. Training may include handstands, cartwheels and floor progressions, bar swings and supports, beam balances and movement skills, and vault running, jumping and landing technique, with progressions selected according to each athlete's current ability. Rising Stars is designed to give gymnasts a strong technical foundation while allowing each athlete to progress at an appropriate pace. Recreational Classes Floor Tumbling & Obstacle Skills Recommended 7+ | 1 hour A floor-focused recreational gymnastics program for athletes who want more time to develop their gymnastics skills on the floor. Gymnasts work through structured progressions that develop the foundations needed for strong floor skills, including body positions and control, handstands, rolls, cartwheels, jumping and landing technique, strength, flexibility and coordination. As athletes build the necessary technique and physical readiness, they progress toward increasingly challenging floor and tumbling skills. Unlike our regular recreational gymnastics programs, this class does not rotate through vault, bars and beam. Training time is dedicated to floor skill development, with obstacle stations and conditioning incorporated to develop the strength, power, agility, spatial awareness and movement control that support gymnastics progression. No previous gymnastics experience is required. Athletes work at their own level and progress according to their ability and readiness. Weekly Class Times Wednesday 4:00pm-5:00pm / 6:30pm-7:30pm Thursday 6:30pm-7:30pm $95/month while enrolled Register

Recreational Classes Flight Crew (Ages 8+) Ages 8+ 1 hour A progressive recreational gymnastics program for older children and youth, welcoming both beginners and gymnasts with previous experience. Athletes train across vault, bars, beam and floor, working through skill progressions matched to their individual level. Beginners establish strong gymnastics fundamentals, while more experienced gymnasts continue refining technique and progressing toward more challenging skills and combinations. Flight Crew gives older athletes the opportunity to learn and progress in gymnastics at their own level without needing previous competitive experience. Recreational Classes Boys Adventure Gym (6+) Ages 6+ 1 hour A boys recreational gymnastics program combining structured gymnastics instruction with strength, agility and obstacle-based training. Athletes develop gymnastics fundamentals through floor skills, swinging and support work, jumping and landing progressions, climbing, strength development and challenging apparatus circuits. Obstacle-based stations are used to develop power, coordination, agility and body control while reinforcing proper gymnastics technique. Boys Adventure Gym is designed for athletes who enjoy an active, dynamic training format while still receiving progressive gymnastics coaching and skill development.
